_comment: Coach and kibitz are DIFFERENT processes, as a real config with GNU Go plus KataGo is. That path is not the same as one engine carrying both flags: KIBITZ_NAV short-circuits `kibitz == coach || coach->play(response)`, so a single-engine config never exercises coach->play() at all.
_comment_wait: No grace period. It ships at 0.5 s so that GNU Go answering a genmove in 13 ms does not flash the mark for a single frame on every move of a bot match; here the point is to assert that the mark was placed, so it should be there as soon as the wait is.
